description: This file defines an interface ITransactionCoordinatorGrain for transaction coordination in an Orleans-based system. It includes method signatures for multi-grain operations, transaction simulations, and error testing, all marked with Orleans transaction attributes.

classes.name: ITransactionCoordinatorGrain
classes.description: Interface for a transaction coordinator grain managing multi-grain transactional operations in Orleans.

methods.name: MultiGrainSet
methods.description: Sets multiple grains to a certain state or value.

methods.name: MultiGrainAdd
methods.description: Adds a value to multiple grains.

methods.name: MultiGrainDouble
methods.description: Doubles the value in multiple grains.

methods.name: MultiGrainDoubleByRWRW
methods.description: Doubles grains' values with specific read-write transaction pattern.

methods.name: MultiGrainDoubleByWRWR
methods.description: Doubles grains' values with an alternate transaction pattern.

methods.name: OrphanCallTransaction
methods.description: Performs a transaction call on a grain, potentially to test orphaned transactions.

methods.name: AddAndThrow
methods.description: Adds a value to a grain and then throws an exception, likely for testing rollback.

methods.name: MultiGrainAddAndThrow
methods.description: Performs additions on multiple grains, then throws an exception.

methods.name: MultiGrainSetBit
methods.description: Sets a specific bit across multiple grains.

methods.name: MultiGrainAdd
methods.description: Adds a value to multiple grains using a committer and operation objects.

methods.name: UpdateViolated
methods.description: Updates a grain in a way that violates transactional constraints for testing.
